cond_0001.intro: The main function of a research engineer is to research and investigate the design, functionality and maintenance of mechanical products, equipment, systems and processes. A typical research engineer has the ability to make engineering drawings, and read and interpret blueprints.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Research, design, develop, manufacture, and test tools, engines, machines and other mechanical devices. Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects. Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.
Creativity, verbal and written communication skills, analytical and problem solving ability. Team player and detail oriented. Ability to make sketches, engineering drawings and common computations. Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawing, schematics and computer-generated reports. Previous experience with computer applications and software related to engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD).
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, plastics technology/engineering, materials science, or related field
1-3 Years of experience in plastic and/or adhesive material selection, manufacturing, and/or design
Good organizational skills, ability to work independently, and good oral and written communication skills
Proficiency with computer, especially with MS Word, Excel, and Outlook
Preferred Requirements
Ability to learn basic print reading and data analysis tools
Willingness and motivation to learn new technologies and concepts

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of mechanical systems and engineering processes.

Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.

Creativity, verbal and written communication skills, analytical and problem solving ability. Team player and detail oriented. Ability to make sketches, engineering drawings and common computations. Previous experience with computer applications and software related to engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD).

cond_0382.intro: The main function of a research engineer is to research and investigate the design, functionality and maintenance of mechanical products, equipment, systems and processes. A typical research engineer has the ability to make engineering drawings, and read and interpret blueprints. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of mechanical systems and engineering processes.
cond_0382.responsibilities:
Research, design, develop, manufacture, and test tools, engines, machines and other mechanical devices. Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects. Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.
Skills
Creativity, verbal and written communication skills, analytical and problem solving ability. Team player and detail oriented. Ability to make sketches, engineering drawings and common computations. Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawing, schematics and computer-generated reports. Previous experience with computer applications and software related to engineering field, such as Computer Aided Design (CAD).

Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects. Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.
cond_0398.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, plastics technology/engineering, materials science, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in plastic and/or adhesive material selection, manufacturing, and/or design, with a minimum of 3 years of proven experience in the field.
Deep knowledge of computer applications relevant to the engineering field, including strong command of MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Advanced knowledge of print reading and data analysis tools.
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly and precisely.
Strong motivation to learn and apply new technologies and concepts, with a track record of doing so in a professional setting.
cond_0398.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0398.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

Creativity, verbal and written communication skills, analytical and problem solving ability. Team player and detail oriented. Ability to make sketches, engineering drawings and common computations. Research and analyze customer design proposals, specifications, manuals to determine time and cost feasibility to complete projects. Assist drafters in developing the structural design of products using tools, equipment or software.
cond_0614.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, plastics technology/engineering, materials science, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in plastic and/or adhesive material selection, manufacturing, and/or design, with a minimum of 3 years of proven experience in the field.
Deep knowledge of computer applications relevant to the engineering field, including strong command of MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Advanced knowledge of print reading and data analysis tools.
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly and precisely.
Strong motivation to learn and apply new technologies and concepts, with a track record of doing so in a professional setting.
cond_0614.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
